{{color box|#005035}} {{color box|#FFFFFF}} {{color box|#A49665}} | mascot = [[Norm the Niner]] |sports_nickname = [[Charlotte 49ers|49ers]] | academic_affiliations = {{hlist|[[Coalition of Urban and Metropolitan Universities|CUMU]]|[[Oak Ridge Associated Universities|ORAU]]|[[Coalition of Urban Serving Universities|USU]]}} | website = {{official URL}} }} [[File:Ucity.jpg|thumb|Aerial view of UNC Charlotte in 2010]] '''The University of North Carolina at Charlotte''' ('''UNC Charlotte''', or simply '''Charlotte''') is a [[public education|public]] [[research university]] in [[Charlotte, North Carolina]], United States. UNC Charlotte offers 24 doctoral, 66 master's, and 79 bachelor's degree programs through nine colleges.{{cite web |url=http://admissions.uncc.edu/academics |title=Academics |date=July 9, 2014 |access-date=May 11, 2017 |archive-date=July 26, 2010 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100726205706/http://admissions.uncc.edu/academics |url-status=live }} It is [[Carnegie Classification of Institutions of Higher Education|classified]] among "R1: Very High Research Spending and Doctorate Production."{{cite web |title=Carnegie Classifications Institution Lookup |url=https://carnegieclassifications.acenet.edu/institution/university-of-north-carolina-at-charlotte/ |publisher=Center for Postsecondary Education |website=carnegieclassifications.iu.edu |access-date=13 February 2025 |archive-date=February 13, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250213151405/https://carnegieclassifications.acenet.edu/institution/university-of-north-carolina-at-charlotte/ |url-status=dead }} The university experienced rapid enrollment growth in the late 2000s and early-mid 2010s when it was the fastest-growing institution in [[University of North Carolina|the UNC System]].{{cite web |url=http://ninertimes.com/2017/06/how-the-n-c-budget-could-impact-unc-charlotte/ |title=How the N.C. budget could impact UNC Charlotte |date=June 27, 2017 |website=ninertimes.com |access-date=October 2, 2017 |archive-date=October 3, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171003033144/http://ninertimes.com/2017/06/how-the-n-c-budget-could-impact-unc-charlotte/ |url-status=dead}} It has two campuses: the Main Campus, located in [[University City, North Carolina|University City]], and the Center City Campus in Uptown Charlotte. The main campus sits on 1,000 wooded acres with approximately 85 buildings about {{convert|8|mi|km}} from Uptown Charlotte.{{cite web |url=http://admissions.uncc.edu/about |title=About UNC Charlotte |date=July 9, 2014 |access-date=May 11, 2017 |archive-date=July 27, 2015 |archive-url=https://wayback.archive-it.org/all/20150727170726/https://admissions.uncc.edu/about-unc-charlotte |url-status=live }}
